title: experimentalUseImportModule should be disabled

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

body:
### What version of Next.js are you using?

12.0.0

### What version of Node.js are you using?

16.1.0

### What browser are you using?

chrome

### What operating system are you using?

macOS

### How are you deploying your application?

next start

### Describe the Bug

Im using a webpack plugin that creates a parallel build for module federation. In production, the build fails with the error:
```
ValidationError: Invalid configuration object. Webpack has been initialized using a configuration object that does not match the API schema.
 - configuration.experiments has an unknown property 'executeModule'. These properties are valid:
   object { asset?, asyncWebAssembly?, buildHttp?, cacheUnaffected?, futureDefaults?, layers?, lazyCompilation?, outputModule?, syncWebAssembly?, topLevelAwait? }
```

this is coming from https://github.com/vercel/next.js/blob/canary/packages/next/build/webpack/config/blocks/css/index.ts#L379, which should not be set in the more recent versions of webpack according to https://github.com/webpack-contrib/mini-css-extract-plugin/blob/master/README.md#experimentalUseImportModule (I believe next is on v5.60?) and has been removed in the latest version (https://github.com/webpack/webpack/pull/14117)

I have a workaround to manually override this value, but would be nice if i didn't have to. I'm open to creating a pr for this if it's as simple as updating the value from `true` to `false` :) thanks!

### Expected Behavior

creating a parallel build doesnt throw an error in production

### To Reproduce

I can't share my code unfortunately, but happy to provide more context if needed.
